guidance: At floor16 MAP, Ironclad 77/84 HP with Strength and Dexterity Potions, upgraded Uppercut, recurring Thrumming Hatchet, Dominate, Vicious/Vulnerable support and Chosen Cheese. Enter the only Boss node, Lagavulin Matriarch, then pause before playing any card so Astra can inspect its actual HP, powers, opening intent and hand. In eventual combat guidance, prioritize damage scaling and Weak mitigation; use both potions if they materially improve survival or kill timing. Do not infer boss mechanics from its name alone.
